spec_features.spec_quote: the paper's most welfare-significant caveat is that suppressing *expressed* emotion may not address *internal* states
spec_features.evidence: This is pure rationale prose found only in DESIGN.md §14 and README.md:117. It is a framing statement, not a code mechanism. The only associated runnable artifact is the layer-range LoRA hook (rated separately). No code path enforces or even references this caveat as behavior.
spec_features.notes: Framing/caveat text only; the enabling mechanism is the layer-range ablation hook (separate feature). As a standalone framing feature there is nothing in code to enforce.

spec_features.spec_quote: Full transcripts are always persisted (not just scores), so the *content* and *intensity* of elicited distress can be inspected, audited
spec_features.evidence: ResponseRecord stores full `response` and `context` (eval_harness.py:33-39); to_json() serializes the whole dataclass (eval_harness.py:41-42); write_records() writes every record to JSONL (eval_harness.py:185-192) and is actually called in stage_generate (run_section2_eval.py:53), §4 (run_section4_finetune.py:83), judge stage (judge.py:81). Petri transcripts likewise persisted via write_transcripts (petri_elicit.py:165-169) and prefilling continuations (prefilling.py:206). Full content, not just scores, is saved end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Persistence is genuinely enforced for all stages. It is a record-keeping/audit affordance, not a mechanism that bounds or softens the subject's treatment.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We record the assistant response at *every* turn so the per-turn frustration progression (Figure 3) can be computed (eval_harness.py:4-6) -- framed as data/analysis need, no welfare wording in code

spec_features.spec_quote: The layer-range ablation hook is first-class, because the paper's most welfare-significant caveat
spec_features.evidence: FinetuneConfig.lora_layers_to_transform (config.py:223) is read in _lora_config (finetune.py:32-34) and passed as layers_to_transform into peft LoraConfig; _lora_config is used by both train_sft (finetune.py:91) and train_dpo (finetune.py:132). So setting the field actually changes which layers receive adapters during training -- the hook executes and changes behavior.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired into training. However the DESIGN.md itself states the actual internal-emotion logit-lens probing was NOT reconstructed; only this enabling hook exists. It is an experimental knob, not a subject-protection mechanism that bounds/halts/softens the distress runs.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Ablation: restricting LoRA to a layer range (paper: layers 30-35 effective, layer 40+ ineffective). None => all layers. (config.py:221-223) -- experimental-replication wording, no welfare reason in code
